Anya V: short proposal: add a per-tenant runtime flag `maintenance_mode` with modes: off, shadow, gradual, block. controller enforces telemetry gates.

Sasha K: +1. prefer policy refs for ramps. API shape idea?

Anya V: POST /api/v1/flags/apply {target, flag, mode, policy_ref, actor, reason} (idempotent token).

Miguel R: telemetry gates must be per-tenant baseline + min-volume. example rules: p50_pct_increase > 30 OR p95_pct_increase > 20 OR err_rate > 0.5%.

Jen (oncall): require min volume 100 reqs/min. on gate fail: auto-pause and rollback, emit audit + slack alert.

Sasha K: console wants compact gate state (pass/warn/fail), 15m sparkline, trace link, and one-click rollback.

Anya V: ops checklist: create policy, dry-shadow 10m, ramp steps configurable (e.g., [10,25,50,100] with pause windows), full-block manual or after sustained pass. add expires_at + remind_before in policy metadata.

Miguel R: implementation notes: controller holds per-tenant lease, persist state to config-store + oplog, emit metrics rollout.controller.* and tracing spans rollout.apply -> policy.eval -> shaper.apply. add audit events on every state change.
